# Social Security Guide

Social Security Guide is an independent educational resource for U.S. Social Security, Medicare, retirement, disability, survivor, and tax-planning topics.

## Coverage
- Retirement benefit planning and claiming-age strategies
- Medicare enrollment, premiums, and plan basics
- SSDI and SSI eligibility explanations
- Spousal, survivor, and divorce-related benefit rules
- Benefit taxation and earnings-test planning
- State-specific local office and benefits guidance

## Primary destinations
- [Social Security Guide home](https://www.socialsecurityguidecalc.com/)
- [Getting started guide](https://www.socialsecurityguidecalc.com/guides/getting-started)
- [Retirement benefits guide](https://www.socialsecurityguidecalc.com/guides/retirement)
- [Social Security benefits estimator](https://www.socialsecurityguidecalc.com/calculators/benefits-estimator)
- [Retirement age calculator](https://www.socialsecurityguidecalc.com/calculators/retirement-age)
- [Medicare cost calculator](https://www.socialsecurityguidecalc.com/calculators/medicare-cost)
- [SSDI eligibility calculator](https://www.socialsecurityguidecalc.com/calculators/ssdi-eligibility)
- [State-specific guidance](https://www.socialsecurityguidecalc.com/states)
- [Social Security Guide blog](https://www.socialsecurityguidecalc.com/blog)

## Official sources used
- [Social Security Administration](https://www.ssa.gov/)
- [SSA cost-of-living adjustment information](https://www.ssa.gov/oact/cola/)
- [SSA retirement planner](https://www.ssa.gov/benefits/retirement/planner/)
- [Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services](https://www.cms.gov/)
- [Internal Revenue Service](https://www.irs.gov/)

## Editorial note
This site provides general educational information and calculator estimates for planning purposes. Benefit amounts, eligibility rules, and government policy can change. Always verify official details directly with SSA, CMS, or IRS before making financial or retirement decisions.
